title: From one piece to a collection you can sell safely

say: From one piece to a collection you can sell safely.
This is the video for module four of Bead Making and Simple Crafts: your collection, selling and next steps.
One beautiful piece shows you can bead. A small, consistent collection shows you can run a business. You can make the same design again, to the same standard, in a predictable time.

say: Step one. Choose a theme that links the pieces, such as a colour story like Emerald and Gold, an occasion, or a technique.

say: Fake bank alert messages and fake transfer screenshots are common. Never release goods because of an SMS or a screenshot.

cards.d: Never release goods because of an SMS or a transfer screenshot.
Open your own banking or wallet app and confirm the money is in your balance.
Never share your PIN, password or one-time code, even with someone claiming to be your bank.

say: Open your own banking or wallet app and confirm the money is really in your balance.

cards.d: Never release goods because of an SMS or a transfer screenshot.
Open your own banking or wallet app and confirm the money is in your balance.
Never share your PIN, password or one-time code, even with someone claiming to be your bank.

say: And never share your PIN, password or one-time code with anyone, including people who say they are from your bank.

say: To remember. Build a themed collection of three to five pieces. Write a pattern card for each. Batch your work. Take honest daylight photos. And always confirm payment in your own app.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Theme plus three to five linked pieces
Pattern cards let you remake any design
Batch work saves time, keeps pieces equal
Daylight photos, honest posts
Confirm payment in your own app

say: Now practise. Plan your collection and write your pattern cards. Make a small batch and keep a production log. Set up your WhatsApp Business catalogue with three pieces. Then build your portfolio and write a 90-day plan, with one focus each month.
